entry.summary: Monaco has no border controls with France; reached through Schengen France, so the Schengen 90/180 rule applies in practice.
entry.max_stay: 90 days in any 180-day period across the Schengen area
entry.next_check: Confirm with Monaco's government whether time there counts toward Schengen days.
